method: Manual player validation reported in the MAP-2M request
coverage: User reports seven checks in a new campaign and one month of simulation without a problem. The existing 341-cell Swedish coastal core and six arms-industry levels in Brandenburg are accepted as the reference. Individual inspected RGBs beyond the core and measured file hashes were not supplied.
interpretation: Manual validation of the prior reference only; does not promote MAP-2M or certify all historical boundaries.
